inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.hold.root
inputs.description: The repository root string used as the run-lock key; only calls with the identical string contend for this lock.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.hold.owner
inputs.description: The object identity requesting the run lock; an existing lock is retained for this same object and refused to a different object.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.release.root
inputs.description: The repository root string identifying the run lock to release; it must match the string used to hold that lock.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.release.owner
inputs.description: The object identity requesting release; only the identical object currently holding this root can release it.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.held.root
inputs.description: The repository root string whose run-lock state is checked; null always produces false.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.exclusive.root
inputs.description: The repository root string used to serialize writes; only identical strings share a write queue.

inputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.exclusive.work
inputs.description: The zero-argument asynchronous work callback queued for this repository root. It runs after earlier queued work settles, and its promise may resolve or reject with T or the callback rejection reason.

outputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.hold
outputs.description: True when this owner holds the run lock after the call; false when a different owner already holds it.

outputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.release
outputs.description: No value is returned; the run lock is deleted only when the supplied owner is its current holder.

outputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.held
outputs.description: True when a non-null root currently has a run lock, and false for null or an unlocked root.

outputs.name: RepositoryArbiterService.exclusive
outputs.description: The fulfilled value is whatever the work callback resolves with. Writes for this exact root run in request order, and the returned promise rejects with the callback rejection reason.

errors.name: work callback rejection
errors.description: exclusive rejects with the reason produced by its work callback; the internal queue recovers so the next queued write for that root can run.
